prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated rustic wooden barrel obstacle sprite for a 2D top-down/three-quarter survivor game, to sit beside an existing broad tree stump and woven wattle fence in a village outskirts field. Transparent square canvas, centered compact silhouette with generous alpha padding, 3/4 top-down view showing the barrel lid and upper front, short stout proportions, slightly uneven oak staves, two dark iron hoops, warm desaturated brown wood, muted ochre highlights, thick subtly irregular dark plum-brown contour, simple matte cel-painted storybook shading, clean readable shape at small gameplay scale. Match a hand-painted Unity cutout prop, not realism. No ground, no cast shadow, no grass, no loose objects, no text, no logos, no frame, no bright glow, no 3D render, no pixel art. At least 1024x1024 resolution. Genuine transparent background.
